title: Proper finite-coefficient coproducts in the ringed-site presentation
statement: Let $O$ be a commutative ring, $t\in O$, and $g:V\to T$ a proper morphism of locally Noetherian quasi-compact schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $A$ be a normalized ordinary etale coefficient-system image for $g$ [def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data]. Fix $n\in\mathbf N$ such that $O/(t)^{n+1}$ is finite. For any universal derived level image $D$ of the ordinary adjunction $A_n^*\dashv A_{n,*}$ in that interface, its direct functor $D.\mathrm{direct}$ preserves coproducts indexed by every type in the sheaf universe. This applies to the actual constant quotient ring sheaves, with their recorded derived-localization choices.

source.place: lemma-proper-mod-n-direct-sums (0F0D), transported along the constant-ring module equivalence and uniqueness of the universal total derived functor; Zheng, Construction 4.1.

proof.text: Identify modules over each constant quotient ring sheaf with sheaves of modules over the quotient ring. The normalized geometric inverse-image comparison gives the ordinary adjunction square, and uniqueness of right adjoints identifies ordinary direct images compatibly with counits.

Exact equivalences induce equivalences of unbounded derived categories. The normalized total right-derived units identify D.direct with the usual derived direct image conjugated by those equivalences, by uniqueness of right-derived functors, or on K-injective representatives.

Apply the finite-ring proper derived coproduct theorem to g. Equivalences preserve all existing coproducts, and colimit preservation transports across natural isomorphisms. This proves the result for every family, including the empty family.

theorem etaleCoefficientProper_coproducts
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (t : O)
    {V T : Scheme.{u}} (g : V ⟶ T) [IsProper g]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian V] [CompactSpace V]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian T] [CompactSpace T]
    (A : StrictEtaleOrdinaryImage O t g) (n : ℕ)
    [Finite (O ⧸ (Ideal.span ({t} : Set O)) ^ (n + 1))]
    (D : CoefficientDerivedImage (A.lift n).modules (A.right n) (A.levelAdj n))
    (I : Type (u + 1)) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) D.direct
